embedding_input: instruction + camera; invariant character/style prefix excluded
limitations: Cosine threshold reduces near duplicates but does not guarantee all tasks are semantically distinct.
t-SNE is a visualization, not a de-duplication guarantee.
Split holds out prompts, not necessarily action families.
No image baseline or human/VLM rubric calibration has been performed.
usage_limitations: Only cached successful generation responses are included; discarded attempts and reviews are not part of this usage subtotal.
review: DeepSeek textual feasibility review; not human-certified and not a check of generated images.
